summary: Full backend + frontend validation of FiscalHub España Spanish invoicing app. 12/12 backend pytest tests passed (auth, company, invoices w/ IVA+IRPF compute, PDF, email via Resend delivered@resend.dev, expenses, dashboard w/ Modelo 303 deadlines, register). Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin login → Panel with all metrics + next-deadline card + quarterly chart, invoice creation dialog with live summary (base 2450,00 € / total 2597,00 € with IVA 21% + IRPF 15%), PDF popup opens, email send success toast, mark-paid toggle, delete, expense creation updates totals, register → /configuracion redirect + settings persistence across reload, Impuestos page shows Modelo 303 table with correct deadlines and 'Próximo' badge.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookies use SameSite=None + Secure which is correct for cross-site preview URL; works fine.
get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']) - safe because sub is always inserted as string of ObjectId.
Dashboard endpoint iterates all invoices/expenses in-memory per request - acceptable for MVP but consider aggregation pipelines at scale.
IVA/IRPF calculations use simple multiplication + rounding; banker's rounding differences could arise on edge cents but current test totals are exact.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/register (only login has lockout) - acceptable for MVP.
compute_invoice mutates and returns dict but return value unused after insert - minor style issue.
test_credentials: admin@fiscalhub.es / admin123 (seeded); registered ephemeral users via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed company, invoices and expenses during automated tests; test invoices/expenses were cleaned up. One registered ephemeral user + TEST_UI Empresa SL remain (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 pytest backend tests pass. Playwright frontend covered: login, register→config, dashboard metrics + deadline card, invoice create (IVA 21%+IRPF 15% → 2597€), PDF popup, email to delivered@resend.dev, mark paid, delete, expense create (base 500 → IVA 105), company persistence, Impuestos deadlines. No issues found.
